To enhance security, cookies can be marked with the "SameSite" attribute, which restricts their usage based on the origin of the page that set them. This attribute can have three values: "Strict," "Lax," or "None". Make sure the `SameSite` attribute of the important cookies (e.g., session cookie) is set to a reasonable value.
